project.name: tarini-agent
project.description: Tarini is a conversational AI agent that onboards Indian rental property operators onto RentOK without forms. Operators describe their property in natural chat (English, Hindi, Hinglish) and Tarini collects, validates, and persists structured listing data across a 5-stage journey via SSE streaming.

nodes.name: Operator Onboarding
nodes.summary: Guides a rental property operator through a structured 5-stage conversational journey to collect all listing data required to publish on RentOK. Manages onboarding state, stage progression, and persistence of property details across sessions.

businessRules: Stages must progress in fixed order: intro → structure → packages → mapping → verification
Stage advancement is atomic and versioned to prevent concurrent corruption
All property data lives in a flexible JSONB state blob keyed by session
crossDomainInteractions: Delegates conversation turns to the AI Conversation domain
Persists and retrieves all state via the Session Persistence domain

nodes.name: AI Conversation
nodes.summary: Drives the natural-language dialogue with the operator using Anthropic Claude. Implements a tool-use loop that streams responses over SSE, dispatches structured tool calls to read and mutate onboarding state, and emits generative UI components to the frontend.

businessRules: Tool-use loop runs for at most MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS per turn to control cost
Message history is trimmed to limit token spend
System prompt enforces language flexibility (English/Hindi/Hinglish) and persona rules
crossDomainInteractions: Reads and writes onboarding state via the Operator Onboarding domain tools
Pushes generative UI events to the Generative UI domain
Reads session history from the Session Persistence domain

nodes.name: Session Persistence
nodes.summary: Manages durable storage of conversation sessions, message history, and onboarding state in Supabase Postgres. Provides an in-memory fallback for local development, handles concurrent query serialisation, and evicts idle sessions after 30 minutes.

businessRules: State updates use atomic Supabase RPC functions to prevent race conditions
Sessions idle longer than 30 minutes are evicted from in-process cache
Concurrent chat queries for the same session are serialised with asyncio locks
crossDomainInteractions: Serves session state and history to the AI Conversation domain
Receives stage and state mutations from the Operator Onboarding domain

nodes.name: Generative UI
nodes.summary: Allows the AI agent to push rich, structured UI components to the frontend over the SSE stream. Claude selects from an allowlist of 20 components (e.g. StageTransitionCard) and the backend serialises them as typed SSE events.

businessRules: Only components in the AVAILABLE_COMPONENTS allowlist may be emitted
StageTransitionCard is emitted on every stage transition with STAGE_LABELS metadata
crossDomainInteractions: Receives emit_ui tool calls from the AI Conversation domain
Stage transition events are built using stage order defined in the Operator Onboarding domain

nodes.name: Start Session
nodes.summary: Creates a new onboarding session for an operator, initialising the DB record and returning a session ID that anchors all subsequent chat turns.

nodes.name: Process Chat Turn
nodes.summary: Receives an operator message, runs the Anthropic tool-use loop, streams SSE events (text chunks, tool calls, UI components, state snapshots) back to the client, and persists updated history and state to Supabase.

nodes.name: Resume Session
nodes.summary: Fetches an existing session's current stage, state, and message history so the frontend can restore a previous onboarding conversation.

nodes.name: Stage Progression
nodes.summary: Handles the agent-initiated transition from one onboarding stage to the next, validating the target stage, atomically writing it to the DB, and emitting a StageTransitionCard UI event to the frontend.

nodes.name: Property Data Collection
nodes.summary: Incrementally reads and deep-merges operator-provided property details (floors, rooms, packages, room-package mappings) into the session state blob via get_state and update_state tool calls during the structure, packages, and mapping stages.

nodes.name: Local Dev CLI Session
nodes.summary: Provides a local interactive chat loop for development, persisting session ID to a .tarini_session file and driving the same agent code path as the HTTP server without standing up FastAPI.

nodes.name: Receive POST /sessions
nodes.summary: FastAPI endpoint accepts the create-session HTTP request and extracts any operator identity payload.

nodes.name: Create DB Session Record
nodes.summary: Calls the Supabase client to insert a new sessions row with initial stage='intro' and empty state JSONB.

nodes.name: Return Session ID
nodes.summary: Returns the generated session UUID to the caller so the frontend can anchor subsequent chat requests.

nodes.name: Receive Operator Message
nodes.summary: FastAPI endpoint accepts the operator's text message and session ID, acquires the per-session asyncio lock to serialise concurrent requests.

nodes.name: Load Session History
nodes.summary: SessionManager retrieves cached message history for the session or loads it from Supabase if not in-process, appending the new operator message.

nodes.name: Run Anthropic Tool-Use Loop
nodes.summary: stream_chat calls the Anthropic API with the full message history and system prompt, iterating up to MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS; each tool call result is appended and fed back until Claude returns a final text response.

nodes.name: Dispatch Tool Calls
nodes.summary: execute_tool routes each tool call (get_state, update_state, advance_stage, emit_ui) to its implementing function and yields tool_start / tool_complete SSE events.

nodes.name: Stream SSE Events to Client
nodes.summary: Yields text delta, tool_start, tool_complete, component, state_snapshot, and done SSE event dicts to the FastAPI streaming response, with keepalive pings.

nodes.name: Persist Updated History
nodes.summary: After the agent turn completes, SessionManager saves the full updated message history back to Supabase and updates the in-process cache.

nodes.name: Fetch Session from DB
nodes.summary: Retrieves the session row from Supabase including current stage, state blob, and versioned message history.

nodes.name: Return Session State
nodes.summary: Returns the current stage, state snapshot, and message history to the frontend so it can render the correct onboarding view.

nodes.name: Validate Target Stage
nodes.summary: advance_stage checks the requested stage against VALID_STAGES = [intro, structure, packages, mapping, verification] and rejects unknown values.

nodes.name: Atomic DB Stage Advance
nodes.summary: Calls the Supabase RPC function to atomically update the session stage, preventing concurrent writes from corrupting the stage value.

nodes.name: Emit StageTransitionCard UI Event
nodes.summary: build_transition_event constructs the typed SSE component event payload for StageTransitionCard, including STAGE_LABELS and the new stage name, and yields it into the stream.

nodes.name: Read Current State
nodes.summary: get_state returns the current stage, full state blob, and state_version so Claude knows what data has already been collected before asking the next question.

nodes.name: Extract Structured Data from Conversation
nodes.summary: Claude parses the operator's natural-language message (English/Hindi/Hinglish) and constructs a structured update dict containing property fields for the current stage.

nodes.name: Deep-Merge State Update
nodes.summary: update_state deep-merges the extracted field updates into the existing state blob and persists via atomic Supabase RPC, preserving previously collected fields.

nodes.name: Emit State Snapshot
nodes.summary: After each update_state call, the agent emits a state_snapshot SSE event so the frontend can render a live preview of collected property data.

nodes.name: Load or Create CLI Session
nodes.summary: Reads .tarini_session file to reuse an existing session ID, or creates a new one and saves it to the file for future runs.

nodes.name: Interactive Chat Loop
nodes.summary: Reads operator input from stdin, calls stream_chat, and prints streamed SSE events to stdout, replicating the production HTTP flow locally.

edges.description: Claude invokes get_state, update_state, and advance_stage tools to read and mutate operator onboarding state during each chat turn
Claude calls emit_ui tool to push generative UI component events (e.g. StageTransitionCard) into the SSE stream
Agent reads and writes message history via SessionManager and Supabase client around every chat turn
Stage advancement and state deep-merges are durably persisted via atomic Supabase RPC calls
StageTransitionCard events reference STAGE_ORDER and STAGE_LABELS defined by the onboarding journey
